description: Header file defining functions, macros, and data types for managing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (nu_ipaddr_t), including address conversion, comparison, and interface-related utilities.

classes.name: nu_ipaddr_t
classes.description: Data type representing an IP address, either IPv4 or IPv6 depending on configuration.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_family
methods.description: Retrieves the address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) from a nu_ipaddr_t address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_inaddr
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t IPv4 address to struct in_addr.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_in6addr
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t IPv6 address to struct in6_addr.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_sockaddr
methods.description: Fills a sockaddr_storage structure with the address and port information from nu_ipaddr_t.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_str
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t address to a human-readable string.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_str
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a string representing the address, using a provided buffer.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_str
methods.description: Parses a string representation of an IP address into nu_ipaddr_t.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_sockaddr_storage
methods.description: Extracts an IP address and port from a sockaddr_storage object into nu_ipaddr_t.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_inaddr
methods.description: Initializes nu_ipaddr_t from a struct in_addr (IPv4).

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_in6addr
methods.description: Initializes nu_ipaddr_t from a struct in6_addr (IPv6).

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_equal
methods.description: Checks if two nu_ipaddr_t addresses are equal.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_copy
methods.description: Copies one nu_ipaddr_t address to another.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_set_zero
methods.description: Sets an nu_ipaddr_t address to zero (unspecified).

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_is_zero
methods.description: Checks if an nu_ipaddr_t address is zero (unspecified).

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_addr_from_dest_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the interface address associated with a destination address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_addr_from_sock_fd
methods.description: Obtains the interface address from a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_name_from_src_addr
methods.description: Gets the interface name based on a source address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_has_interface_addr_changed
methods.description: Checks if the interface address has changed.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_ip_supported_families
methods.description: Detects supported IP address families (IPv4/IPv6).

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_is_valid_interface
methods.description: Validates if a network interface is valid.

methods.name: tw_ulib_diags_family_to_protocol_version
methods.description: Converts address family to protocol version string.

methods.name: tw_ulib_lookup_host
methods.description: Resolves a hostname to an IP address with preferred family.

methods.name: tw_ulib_get_dev_ipaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a device interface.

methods.name: tw_ulib_dev_get_live_wan_address
methods.description: Gets the live WAN IP address (conditional compilation).
